title: Pantheon SessionPersona
description: Session persona object — the control-layer record that binds a persona identity to a concrete task context and freezes effective capabilities at session start.

persona_id.description: The persona this session belongs to.

capability_snapshot_id.description: The CapabilitySnapshot frozen at session start. Immutable for the session lifetime.

context_bundle_ref.description: Reference to the context bundle for this session (replay/audit anchor).

task_ref.description: Reference to the task being executed in this session.

runtime_binding_id.description: The active RuntimeBinding at session start. Required for deployment-bound sessions (interactive, background_job); null for research/consult/red_team sessions. This is the first-class link between session context and the Execution Plane — do not push this into context_bundle_ref metadata.

deployment_stage.description: Deployment stage of the RuntimeBinding at session start. Set iff runtime_binding_id is set. Carries the deployment_mode from RuntimeBinding as a first-class session audit field.

capital_pool_id.description: Capital pool the session is acting against. Set iff runtime_binding_id is set. Together with runtime_binding_id and deployment_stage, completes the session audit chain: Persona → SessionPersona → RuntimeBinding → DeploymentPlan → PersonaCapitalBinding.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier for audit correlation.

ended_at.description: Session end time (UTC ISO-8601). Null while active.
